appearance: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG battle character: Sun Wukong, an original chibi golden monkey king based on Chinese mythology. The reference image is ONLY for body proportions, three-quarter facing-right stance and game-art rendering. Keep its compact stocky muscular fighter silhouette, large fists, short legs, oversized red-and-gold wrist guards and a small curved tail. Transform the identity completely into a clearly recognizable golden monkey: warm amber-brown fur everywhere, peach/tan bare monkey muzzle and rounded ears, expressive amber eyes, no panda markings, golden brow circlet, flame-shaped swept golden hair gathered into a short topknot, red cord, rich vermilion and antique gold armor, chest covered with warm russet fur and a red-gold segmented collar, red silk waist panels and sash, brown monkey fingers and feet. Friendly defiant grin. Small decorative cloud engravings. Entire character visible centered with transparent background, high-quality crisp painterly mobile game sprite, clean edges. Do not add a staff or extra props: this character uses the supplied unarmed fighter skeleton. Do not include text, floor, frame or other figures.
brief: 制作原创齐天大圣悟空猴王，严格以已导入的金甲猴王形象为统一风格参考。把熊猫的所有部件重新设计为猴子对应部件：金棕色猴毛、桃棕色裸露猴指与脚趾，头部是明确的猴脸、桃色口鼻、圆猴耳、金色紧箍、琥珀眼，去除熊猫黑眼圈和黑白毛。头发和马尾为金色毛发红绳束发。躯干和肩臂均为金棕猴毛，护腕和护甲为红漆与古金云纹，丝绸腰带为朱红配金边，项链为红金装饰珠片。尾巴为连续金棕色长猴尾，无黑白环纹。保持每个输入部件原有的精确形状、方向、比例、接缝、关节位置和透明留白，不要把完整形象复制到部件内。F_ 部件是相同角色的另一个朝向，保持参考的视角。head 只画头部，不要画马尾或躯干；F_head 按其原有后脑视角绘制，不额外添正面脸；jaw/cheek/mouth 只绘制原来对应的面部碎片。手指部件只画单独指块，不画整只手。所有纹理均为手绘游戏风格，统一光照、饱和度与描边。唯一 shadow 区域保持原来的扁椭圆形透明柔和落地影，改为深暖褐色。其余部件不添加投影或背景。不添加金箍棒、武器、文字或额外肢体，不改变模板骨架。
